description.value: Des Panjaab is a fully vegetarian Indian restaurant on Tillicum Road in Victoria specializing in authentic Punjabi cuisine, with a menu spanning tandoori paneer, dal makhani, biryani, Indian street food, and freshly baked breads. It also offers an extensive drinks menu including mango lassi, masala chai, and a wide range of virgin mocktails. Both dine-in and takeout are available, making it a practical stop for plant-based fuel on a cycling tour through the Victoria and Saanich area.
